import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 20;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int n, tt, tot = 1, b[] = new int[1000], q[] = new int[1000000], a[][] = new int[1000000][3], dep[][] = new int[N][N], dis[][] = new int[N][N], p[][] = new int[N][N], s[][] = new int[N][N];
    static char ma[][] = new char[N][N], mb[][] = new char[N][N];
    static int[] d = new int[N * N];

    static int[][] c = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}};

    static void add(int x, int y, int c) {
        a[++tot][0] = y;
        a[tot][1] = c;
        a[tot][2] = b[x];
        b[x] = tot;
        a[++tot][0] = x;
        a[tot][1] = 0;
        a[tot][2] = b[y];
        b[y] = tot;
    }

    static void bfs(int x0, int y0, boolean flag) {
        int l = 1, r = 1, id = p[x0][y0];
        q[l++] = x0 * 1000 + y0;
        Arrays.fill(dis, 63);
        Arrays.fill(d, 0);
        int inf = dis[0][0];
        dis[x0][y0] = 0;
        while (l <= r) {
            int x0_ = q[l - 1] / 1000, y0_ = q[l - 1] % 1000;
            if (flag && s[x0_][y0_] != 0 && dis[x0_][y0_] <= tt && dis[x0_][y0_] <= dep[x0_][y0_]) {
                add(id, s[x0_][y0_], INF);
            }
            if (dis[x0_][y0_] > tt || dis[x0_][y0_] >= dep[x0_][y0_]) {
                continue;
            }
            if (id == 3 && s[x0_][y0_] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dis[x0_][y0_]);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x = x0_ + c[i][0], y = y0_ + c[i][1];
                if (x > 0 && x <= n && y > 0 && y <= n && Character.isDigit(ma[x][y]) && dis[x][y] == INF) {
                    dis[x][y] = dis[x0_][y0_] + 1;
                    q[++r] = x * 1000 + y;
                }
            }
            l++;
        }
    }

    static boolean build() {
        Arrays.fill(d, 0);
        int l = 1, r = 1;
        q[l++] = S;
        d[S] = 1;
        while (l <= r) {
            int x = q[l - 1];
            for (int i = b[x]; i != 0; i = a[i][2]) {
                int y = a[i][0];
                if (d[y] != 0 || a[i][1] == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                d[y] = d[x] + 1;
                q[++r] = y;
                if (y == T) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            l++;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dinic(int x, int flow) {
        if (x == T) {
            return flow;
        }
        int k = flow;
        for (int i = b[x]; i != 0; i = a[i][2]) {
            int y = a[i][0];
            if (d[y] != d[x] + 1 || a[i][1] == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            int t = dinic(y, Math.min(k, a[i][1]));
            k -= t;
            a[i][1] -= t;
            a[i ^ 1][1] += t;
            if (k == 0) {
                return flow;
            }
        }
        if (k == flow) {
            d[x] = -1;
        }
        return flow - k;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        tt = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            ma[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            mb[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        Arrays.fill(dep, 63);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (ma[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(dis, 0, dep, 0, dis.length);
        int t = 1;
        S = 0;
        T = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(ma[i][j])) {
                    p[i][j] = ++t;
                    add(S, t, ma[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(mb[i][j])) {
                    s[i][j] = ++t;
                    add(t, T, mb[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (p[i][j] != 0) {
                    bfs(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = 0;
        while (build()) {
            ans += dinic(S, INF);
        }
        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }
}
